description: Index of a sampled velocity polygon and optional conditional certificate for the continuous contour.

bound_provenance.description: Caller-supplied bound provenance, copied without independent verification.
bound_provenance.title: Bound Provenance

certified_index.description: Continuous-field index only when homotopy guard passes under supplied bounds.
certified_index.title: Certified Index

integer_residual.description: Absolute difference between sampled phase sum / 2 pi and nearest integer.
integer_residual.title: Integer Residual

minimum_certified_clearance.description: Minimum chord distance minus B_e * arc_length_e / 2; must exceed point_floor.
minimum_certified_clearance.title: Minimum Certified Clearance

minimum_chord_distance.description: Minimum distance to origin across velocity-space polygon segments.
minimum_chord_distance.title: Minimum Chord Distance

reasons.description: Diagnostics, including unresolved aliasing or failing bound.
reasons.title: Reasons

refinement_recommended.description: True for unresolved bounds or undersampling; resampling alone does not create a certificate.
refinement_recommended.title: Refinement Recommended

sampled_index.description: Integer degree of safe velocity polygon; None if a polygon guard failed. Not by itself a continuous-field index.
sampled_index.title: Sampled Index

sampled_valid.description: Sampled points, chords, phase margin and integer residual pass.
sampled_valid.title: Sampled Valid

status.description: certified is conditional on supplied whole-segment bounds being correct, not inferred from finite samples.
status.title: Status

winding_valid.description: True ONLY for certified continuous-field winding; sampled-only is not certified.
winding_valid.title: Winding Valid

title: VelocityWindingResult
